canvas.coords: pixels, origin top-left of canvas, y down
canvas.draw_order: back to front = list order below
canvas.facing: frontal/symmetric (no flip needed; game enemies face lower-left)

01_shadow.note: multiply/alpha black; scale x with float height

02_wing_L_inner.note: shoulder root (hidden behind hood). screen-left wing, lower blades

03_wing_L_outer.note: same root; upper blades incl. tip. lag inner by ~0.15 cycle

07_face_inner.note: folded mask + hood interior, seen through the hood opening (drawn behind body). small nod/bob only (<=2deg, <=4px)

08_body.note: hood+robe+cape (opening cut out); root of the rig
